findings: Reported times, rates and percentage increases are accurate.
Keep CPU for the current training loop; this does not establish suitability for larger models or differently optimized updates.
Distinguish the full training result from the repeated-rollout microbenchmark.
MPS128 versus CPU128 sampled difference is +0.93 pp, conditional 95% interval -1.33 to +3.13 pp; no demonstrated quality advantage.
10647 games are repeated evaluations of 273 openings from 32 campaigns, including 16 boss openings.
Greedy MPS128 versus CPU128 interval is -5.86 to +0.54 pp; the conditional five-point margin is unsupported.
Keeping the current CPU/default batch configuration is reasonable; no improved greedy gameplay or general noninferiority claim is warranted.

limitations: One shared saved untrained initialization and two exploration/shuffle seeds.

protocol.checkpoint_format: CPU inference bundles with owner-only experimental audit state; no production exact-resume support
protocol.conclusion_rule: A speed improvement alone is insufficient; report paired clustered 95% intervals versus cpu16 and cpu128. Do not claim noninferiority if the lower bound crosses -5 percentage points. Two training seeds are a pilot, not population-level seed evidence.
protocol.initialization: One saved untrained actor shared across arms and both exploration/shuffle seeds
protocol.primary: Final sampled combat win rate, with ordinary/elite/boss equally weighted; paired by source campaign.
protocol.scope: Fresh weights from the saved untrained actor; no optimizer continuation, test evaluation, production device change, or automatic model promotion.

statistics.bootstrap: Resample whole source campaigns jointly across action repeats and the two fixed learner seeds; recompute room-kind denominators and equal-kind average; reject draws missing any kind.
statistics.noninferiority: Descriptive support only if lower conditional bootstrap bound exceeds -0.05; conservative bound and each seed must also be reported; no formal equivalence claim across learner seeds.
statistics.primary: Sampled win rate, equal ordinary/elite/boss weighting at 50k
statistics.uncertainty: Percentile 95% cluster bootstrap plus conservative fixed-weight group Hoeffding bounds; per-seed and pooled. Conditional on this shared initialization and these two learner seeds.

timing.note: Preparation, learner invocations and evaluation are measured separately. Implementation and review elapsed times were not isolated.
